title: Media player pause and saved setting behavior
summary: Reviews mention media playback behavior, with one praising a configurable setting reset experience and one describing pause behavior on Android without a clear sentiment.

positive.summary: One positive review says the system can be set up again when a saved option appears dropped, implying the playback setting behavior is manageable.

undetermined.summary: One undetermined review describes the player pausing and staying paused on Android with MediaMonkey, but it does not clearly express satisfaction or dissatisfaction.

limitations: The topic is based on only two reviews, so examples are insufficient for broader conclusions.
The positive example is ambiguous and may reflect a workaround or setup experience rather than clearly favorable playback performance.
The undetermined example is highly specific to Android and MediaMonkey, which may limit comparability to other playback contexts.
